title: Agentic SE cohort calendar
description: The session dates for one cohort. The course owner publishes one file per cohort; learners load it once into their browser. Sessions are optional per week: a week without an entry shows no date. Times are shown as written, with the timezone label, and are never converted.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this format. A reader refuses any other number.

cohort.description: Name of the cohort, for example early-2026. Copied into learner.cohort in progress exports.

note.description: Optional. Free text for the owner, ignored by readers (the sample file uses it to say it is a sample).

timezone.description: Optional. Label for the times, usually an IANA name such as Europe/London. Shown next to each time; no conversion is done.

sessions.description: One entry per live session. Each week appears at most once (the reader rejects duplicates).

date.description: Calendar date of the session, YYYY-MM-DD. The reader also checks that the date exists.

time.description: Optional. Start time, 24-hour HH:MM, in the calendar's timezone.

place.description: Optional. Room, address or meeting link, as text or a URL.
